info.title: API.SH: Ocado
info.description: The Ocado API from API.SH: public Ocado data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Ocado's category tree: each node has its id (use it in /ocado/v1/category), name and link, with its sub-categories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocado-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products of one Ocado category with the same fields, sorts and filters as search. Category ids come from /ocado/v1/categories. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocado-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Category id (e.g. 40495) or an ocado.com category link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, unit_price_asc, unit_price_desc, rating.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Only these brands (comma-separated, as in the brands facet).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any other facet: facet_id:value[,value], several separated by ; (ids from `facets`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Ocado offer (multibuy, fixed price, bundle…): description, terms, start and end dates and every product in it with price, unit price and rating. Pass the offer `id` from a product's promotions, or `product` to get that product's current offer.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocado-offer

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Offer id (e.g. 300606841) or an ocado.com promotions link.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: A product id: its current offer is returned (use instead of id).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, unit_price_asc, unit_price_desc, rating.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of one Ocado product: rating, title, text, nickname, date, verified-buyer flag, helpful votes and photos, plus the review count and rating distribution. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocado-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id (e.g. 78914011) or a product link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: newest (default), oldest, highest_rating, lowest_rating, most_helpful.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Ocado (UK) product search with every sort and filter the shop offers. Each product has its id, link, name, brand, pack size, price and unit price, availability, rating and review count, offers (multibuys, fixed prices, with links), labels (vegetarian, price promise…), shelf life, category path, sponsored flag and images. The first page also has `facets` (brands, offers/new and other filters), the matching categories with counts and the sort options. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocado-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
